title: BC's Custom Music Disc Sounds
description: This Resource Pack Adds Custom Music Disc Sounds Into Minecraft. Using The Vanilla Discs Just With a Modified Sound! - 2 Version Out Now!
body:
**Resource Pack Function:** 
This Resource Pack Adds Custom Music Disc Sounds Into Minecraft. Using The Vanilla Discs Just With a Modified Sound.
 
- Disc 13, Phonk
- Disc Creator, Billion Dollar Baby
- Disc Creator Music Box, Montagem Miau
- Disc Wait, Lush Life

With More Coming Soon.
This Has Been Done By Changing The Sound Files Of The Music Disc's To a Custom Made One In The Files. This Resource Pack Does Just That.
